topic: Sum of an AP and Arithmetic Mean
title: Add 1 to 100 Fast! Sum of an AP Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Can you add every number from 1 to 100 in less than ten seconds? A famous story says young Carl Friedrich Gauss did it in moments, with one clever idea about pairs. In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 8, Sequences and Series) we turn that idea into the sum of any arithmetic progression and meet the arithmetic mean.

You will watch the sum written forwards and backwards until every column makes 101, see a staircase of blocks fill half a rectangle as n grows live, and derive Sn = n/2 (a + l) and Sn = n/2 [2a + (n - 1)d] step by step. Then the arithmetic mean as meeting a friend halfway, and how to fit k means between two numbers. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example, the exam trap about counting odd numbers, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself. Note: the sum of an AP is a Class 10 NCERT topic and is no longer in the Class 11 NCERT text, but JEE Main still asks it.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
